tools.name: list_collections
tools.description:
List all document collections with doc counts and on-disk sizes.

    Use this to discover what knowledge bases are available before calling
    `query` or `list_documents`.

tools.name: query
tools.description:
Run a research question against one or more collections.

    Returns a synthesized answer plus a `sources` list where each entry has
    `doc_id`, `url`, `source_file`, and `page_number` so the caller can link
    users back to the original PDFs.

    Args:
        question: The research question to answer.
        depth: 'quick' for a single-pass search, 'deep' for multi-agent
            iteration (slower, more thorough).
        collections: Restrict search to named collections. None searches all.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description:
List originals that have chunks indexed in the given collection.

    Each entry includes `doc_id`, `filename`, `url`, and `chunk_count`. Use
    `url` to fetch the raw PDF over HTTP; MCP itself returns references only.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description:
Return metadata and a download URL for a corpus document.

    MCP does not return PDF bytes — fetch them over HTTP from the returned
    `url`. This tool's main value is validating the filename and confirming
    the file exists before the caller sends users to a broken link.
